verdict.rationale: Docs claim SDKs and even the MCP server are generated from/read a 'live OpenAPI spec' (kintsugi-docs-10, kintsugi-docs-18, kintsugi-docs-30), implying a machine-readable spec exists, but a hands-on probe found all standard OpenAPI spec download paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.) return 404, meaning no publicly downloadable spec file was found. missing for 10: a documented public URL or download link for the OpenAPI/Swagger file itself, confirmation that the spec is accessible outside the MCP server's internal use.
